identificationModule.briefTitle: Sotorasib in Advanced Solid Tumors With KRAS G12C Mutation (CodeBreaK 100)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2, Study Evaluating the Safety, Tolerability, PK, and Efficacy of AMG 510 in Subjects With Solid Tumors With a Specific KRAS Mutation

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject has provided informed consent prior to initiation of any study specific activities/procedures.
* Male or female, aged >=18 years.
* Pathologically documented, locally-advanced or metastatic malignancy with KRAS p.G12C mutation identified through molecular testing.
* Subjects with active brain metastases from non-brain tumors are eligible if they have been treated and are without evidence of progression or hemorrhage for at least 4 weeks. Anticonvulsants and steroids are allowed if being administered at stable doses for at least 30 days before study day 1.
* Measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors 1.1 (RECIST 1.1) criteria.
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of <=2.
* Life expectancy of >3 months, in the opinion of the investigator.
* Adequate organ function.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection requiring systemic therapy.
* Known positive test for human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis C virus, chronic active hepatitis B infection.
* Myocardial infarction within 6 months of study day 1, symptomatic congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association > class II), unstable angina, or unstable cardiac arrhythmia requiring medication.
* Gastrointestinal (GI) tract disease causing the inability to take oral medication, malabsorption syndrome, requirement for intravenous alimentation, uncontrolled inflammatory GI disease.
* Prior therapy with a direct and selective KRAS G12C inhibitor.
* Anti-tumor therapy within 28 days of study day 1.
* Therapeutic or palliative radiation therapy within 4 weeks of study day 1.
* Currently receiving treatment in another investigational device or drug study.
* Female subjects of childbearing potential unwilling to use an acceptable method(s) of effective contraception during treatment.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Adagrasib in Previously Treated Patients With NSCLC and KRAS G12C Mutation (KRYSTAL-1)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase 1/2 Study of MRTX849 in Patients With Cancer Having a KRAS G12C Mutation

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically confirmed diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic NSCLC.
* Presence of KRAS G12C mutation in tumor tissue.
* Prior treatment with at least one systemic anti-cancer therapy for advanced disease including an anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody (unless contraindicated).
* Adequate organ function.
* ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
* Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
* Age >= 18 years.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active brain metastases (patients with treated, stable brain metastases are eligible).
* Prior treatment with a KRAS G12C-specific inhibitor.
* Recent major surgery within 4 weeks.
* History of intestinal disease or major gastric surgery that would impair drug absorption.
* Serious cardiac illness including congestive heart failure NYHA class III or IV.
* Pregnant or breastfeeding.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC With Acquired Resistance
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Osimertinib Continuation Beyond Progression in EGFR Mutation Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically or cytologically confirmed NSCLC.
* Documented EGFR mutation known to be associated with EGFR TKI sensitivity (including exon 19 deletion, L858R, T790M).
* Prior treatment with a first- or second-generation EGFR TKI.
* Radiographic progression on prior EGFR TKI therapy.
* Age >= 18 years.
* ECOG performance status 0-2.
* Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
* Adequate hematologic, hepatic, and renal function.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Symptomatic CNS metastases requiring immediate local therapy.
* Interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
* Prior treatment with osimertinib or other third-generation EGFR TKI.
* Concurrent malignancy requiring active therapy.
* Serious cardiac disease including QTc > 470 ms.
